tokens.name: shell-950
tokens.usage: The navy workspace shell: desktop sidebar, mobile top bar, auth left panel, student focus rail. Tailwind: bg-shell-950.

tokens.name: shell-900
tokens.usage: Hover fill for nav items on the shell; ground of the workspace block.

tokens.name: shell-800
tokens.usage: Active nav item fill and hairline dividers on the shell. Never used on paper.

tokens.name: shell-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on shell-950 / shell-900 / shell-800 (16.8:1 on shell-950).

tokens.name: shell-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the shell: nav group labels, role line, plan line (8.3:1 on shell-950, 7.3:1 on shell-900).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: App background behind every instructor and student screen. Warm off-white; never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells and recessed zones: table header band, syllabus rail, quiz option hover, code blocks in lessons.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The one raised plane per screen (e.g. the course editor canvas, the lesson page column). Use sparingly — most content sits directly on paper.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, popovers, the AI assistant panel and the certificate sheet. White is reserved for things you write on or print.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, paper-sunk, surface and surface-raised (15.8:1 on paper).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, table body, reader captions. 7.2:1 on paper, 6.6:1 on paper-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Metadata only (counts, dates, mono labels). 5.3:1 on paper, 4.8:1 on paper-sunk — do not place on tinted fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: row separators, section rules, reader rules. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries: input and secondary-button borders, checkbox outlines (3.4:1 on paper, 3.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Electric indigo. The ONE action colour on paper: primary buttons, links, focus ring, selected tab underline, done-state stations. White text on it is 7.1:1.

tokens.name: primary-dark
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed primary; link hover; primary text on primary-tint (8.1:1).

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Selected row and selected quiz option ground; the current-lesson highlight in the syllabus. Text on it is ink or primary-dark.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-dark fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lamplight amber — the 'you are here' colour: the current station on the Cohort Line, the active-nav station dot, the certificate seal. Text on it is ink (8.5:1). Never a button fill.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text on paper or warning-tint (5.6:1): 'In progress' labels, streak notes.

tokens.name: focus-on-shell
tokens.usage: Focus ring on shell surfaces, where primary only reaches 2.7:1. Amber reaches 9.2:1 on shell-950.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed / paid / active status text and icons on paper (5.1:1) and success-tint (4.8:1). Always paired with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of success status chips and the 'certificate issued' banner.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Expiring / past-due-soon text and icons on paper and warning-tint (5.1:1). Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of warning chips and the renewal notice in Plan & Billing.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive and failed states: text on paper (5.1:1), fill for confirm-destructive buttons with on-primary text (5.7:1).

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of error messages and failed-payment notices; danger text on it is 4.8:1.

tokens.name: art-1-ground
tokens.usage: Course artwork palette 1 (Indigo) ground. Default for Data & Analytics.

tokens.name: art-1-figure
tokens.usage: Course artwork palette 1 figure — shapes and the course code on art-1-ground (6.9:1).

tokens.name: art-2-ground
tokens.usage: Course artwork palette 2 (Pine) ground. Default for People & Leadership.

tokens.name: art-2-figure
tokens.usage: Course artwork palette 2 figure on art-2-ground (8.0:1).

tokens.name: art-3-ground
tokens.usage: Course artwork palette 3 (Clay) ground. Default for Design & Creative.

tokens.name: art-3-figure
tokens.usage: Course artwork palette 3 figure on art-3-ground (6.4:1).

tokens.name: art-4-ground
tokens.usage: Course artwork palette 4 (Harbour) ground. Default for Engineering & Frontend.

tokens.name: art-4-figure
tokens.usage: Course artwork palette 4 figure on art-4-ground (7.7:1).

tokens.name: art-5-ground
tokens.usage: Course artwork palette 5 (Ledger) ground. Default for Finance & Business.

tokens.name: art-5-figure
tokens.usage: Course artwork palette 5 figure on art-5-ground (9.9:1).

tokens.name: art-6-ground
tokens.usage: Course artwork palette 6 (Plum) ground. Default for Compliance & General.

tokens.name: art-6-figure
tokens.usage: Course artwork palette 6 figure on art-6-ground (8.1:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Auth panel statement, certificate recipient name. One per screen, max.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The H1 of every instructor and student page. 32px/36px below 768px.

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: H2 inside a page: dashboard zones, editor sections, billing blocks.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Typography-driven metrics on dashboards. Always with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums. 36px below 768px.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Course titles in lists, person names in directory rows, panel titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Invite learners by email or import a CSV.
styles.usage: Default UI text on instructor and student screens (not lesson content).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense rows, helper text under inputs, table cells.

styles.name: metadata
styles.usage: Counts, durations, dates beside titles. Colour ink-3.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and tab labels. Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and structural labels: section numbers, nav group labels, step numbers 01–05. Uppercase via CSS.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Certificate IDs, course codes (DS·101), invoice numbers, inline code in lessons.

styles.name: reader-title
styles.usage: Lesson H1 in the editorial reader. 32px/38px below 768px.

styles.name: reader-body
styles.sample: Before fitting any model, spend time with the data itself.
styles.usage: Lesson body copy. Measure capped at reader-measure (68ch). 18px/30px below 768px.

styles.name: reader-lede
styles.sample: Learn to read a dataset before you trust it.
styles.usage: The one-sentence lesson summary under the reader title.

spacing.note: Names match Tailwind's default numeric scale (1 = 4px), so these are bg/p/m/gap utilities with no config change.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips; metadata separators.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding in the people directory and syllabus.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; input horizontal padding; gap inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tablet gutter; padding of panels (billing, assistant); gap between list rows with artwork.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; gap between dashboard zones in the same band.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page intro and first content band; between reader paragraphs groups and media.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between major page bands on desktop; certificate inner margin.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Auth panel and reader top padding on wide screens. Never inside dense admin views.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, status chip corners, keyboard hints, code spans.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, tabs. Cohortly buttons are NOT pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels and popovers: AI assistant, billing panel, dropdowns, the one raised plane per screen.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Course artwork tiles and the auth visual panel only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, Cohort Line stations and progress bar ends. Nothing rectangular gets it.

shadow.note: Depth comes from paper vs surface vs shell contrast first. Shadows are for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Raised plane edge (surface on paper). Pair with a line hairline, never stack.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: popovers, menus, the expanded AI assistant, mobile sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The certificate sheet on screen (removed in print).

size.note: Layout constants for tailwind theme.extend (width / maxWidth / minHeight).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Instructor and student desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Collapsed student focus rail inside course overview and lesson reader.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Mobile top bar and in-page header band.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of admin content on paper.

tokens.name: reader-measure
tokens.usage: Max line length of lesson body copy.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for any control below 1024px; 40px button height is allowed on desktop only.
